page.title: TMDb links

Each link makes Jellyfin identify the item as that film or show, replacing its title, overview and images with TMDb's; there is no undo, and your files and folders are never touched.

catchUp.title: Update Jellyfin
catchUp.description: Links set before the app made Jellyfin identify items only put TMDb's ids on them: Jellyfin still shows the titles, overviews and images it took from the file names. Update Jellyfin makes Jellyfin identify each such item as its link, in the background: it replaces the item's title, overview and images with TMDb's — a series' in minutes — and there is no undo. Your files and folders are not touched. A link Jellyfin or the app refuses stays as it is, with its reason, under Not identified.
